summary: This bill establishes a pilot program to provide grants to states and tribal organizations to supplement the wages of child care workers, aiming to increase the supply and quality of child care services.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a pilot program to provide grants to states, Indian Tribes, and Tribal organizations to supplement the wages of child care workers. By increasing the wages of child care workers, the bill aims to improve the quality and availability of child care services, which can be seen as a form of social support for families. This expands government involvement in supporting a service that helps families, aligning with an expansion of the social safety net.
